test_BART_tree_num_nodes: test the BART Tree class to verify it correctly counts the total number of nodes
test_BART_tree_growable_leaves: test the BART Tree growable_leaf_nodes method to identify which leaves can be grown given input data
test_BART_tree_prediction: test the BART Tree predict method to verify predictions match expected sign patterns for input features
test_BART_tree_prune_mutation: test the BART Tree prune mutation to verify a SplitNode is correctly replaced and node count decreases
test_BART_tree_grow_mutation: test the BART Tree grow mutation to verify a LeafNode is correctly split and node count increases
